cohort: The study cohort consisted of women attending perinatal psychiatry services in India between January 2016 and December 2021, specifically those prescribed aripiprazole during pregnancy and who continued the drug postpartum with available lactation data.
finding: The majority of women (74% experienced complete lactation failure, 11% insufficient milk production) who continued aripiprazole through pregnancy and postpartum experienced either lactation failure or insufficient milk production.
